title: DB migration: add did_sig_valid to overview table
description:
What: Add did_sig_valid column to the overview SQLite table and update the Rust struct and store.

Algorithm:
1. Create new migration file crates/reader/migrations/YYYYMMDD_did_sig.sql with: ALTER TABLE overview ADD COLUMN did_sig_valid INTEGER;  (NULL=no DID sig present, 0=invalid, 1=valid)
2. In crates/reader/src/store/overview.rs: add pub did_sig_valid: Option<bool> to OverviewRecord struct
3. Update OverviewStore::insert() signature to accept did_sig_valid: Option<bool>, add it to the INSERT statement
4. Update all callers of insert() to pass None (existing call sites in lifecycle.rs/extract_overview path)
5. Update OverviewStore::query_range() and query_by_msgid() SELECT to include did_sig_valid column, map INTEGER to Option<bool>

Defensive programming:
- Use INTEGER (not BOOLEAN) in SQLite — SQLite has no native boolean
- NULL means absent (no X-Usenet-IPFS-DID-Sig header), 0 means verification failed, 1 means verified
- Migration must be idempotent (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN is idempotent in SQLite if column doesn't exist, but wrap in a check if needed)
- All existing INSERT calls pass None for did_sig_valid
